captions.detailed: A compound angle vise assembly featuring a dark grey rectangular base plate and a rotating swivel platform. Above the swivel base sits a tilting stage section supported by vertical brackets, which holds the main vise bed. The vise itself comprises a light grey guide bed with prismatic dovetail rails, a fixed rear jaw block, a movable front jaw block, and a central steel leadscrew equipped with a turning handle. The system allows for horizontal rotation at the base, angular tilting of the vise body, and linear sliding of the front jaw to clamp objects.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a compound angle vise using CadQuery. The model should include a bottom swivel base plate, a tilting intermediate bracket, a main vise bed with dovetail guide rails, a fixed jaw, and a movable jaw driven by a central leadscrew shaft and handle.
captions.factory: Construct the base plate using a flat box primitive and add a cylinder to represent the swivel joint interface. Model the tilting bracket using combined box primitives to form the support ears and central pivot. Build the main vise bed by extruding a custom 2D sketch with angled cuts for the dovetail ways. Create the fixed jaw, sliding jaw, and jaw plates using box primitives, and use a cylinder for the leadscrew rod combined with a small hexagonal prism and thin cylinders for the handle assembly.
